name: ABB IO Read
description: Read a digital or analog I/O signal from an ABB controller with a single direct synchronous RWS read. Pure observe: never sets a signal. The analog toggle selects float (analog) versus int (digital); defaults to digital.

inputParameters.name: controller
inputParameters.description: RWS session from the ABB Controller component. Unconnected yields no output and no error.

inputParameters.name: signal
inputParameters.description: I/O signal name to read. Blank yields no output and no error.

inputParameters.name: analog
inputParameters.description: Read an analog signal (float) instead of a digital one (int). Auto-creates a boolean toggle; defaults to false (digital).

outputParameters.name: value
outputParameters.description: The signal's current value: an int for a digital read, a float for an analog read.
